description:
Novum Agrum Extractions v.04

Click the flag above for download. Compatible with version 0.98a-RC8The download is a google drive link that says it's "empty" but it should still work after pressing the download button in the top right

A independent mining company turned into a vengeful conglomerate after getting pushed out of the core worlds due to their supposed intense rivalry and corporate warfare. They are specialized in converting midline civilian ships into improvised combat vessels capable of self defense. Necessity breeds creativity, is the motto the people of the NAX adhere to. Their civilian equipment now converted into desperate tools of survival.

Located in the Hadley system, way down south from the core worlds near the abyss.

Despite all that, the people remain divided within the conglomerate... a unknown man simply known as CEO Morrison who seized control of the finances and managed to keep everything afloat thanks to his vast resources and connections. Despite his near anonymous nature nobody would dare to question his leadership or motivation, for he can make anything happen- for no cost is too great.

This mod features mining and salvage ships along with military-turned-security ships. The weapons ranges from converted mining tools to conventional military hardware. The mod was mostly inspired by various corporations in fiction: Concordance Extraction Corporation, Weyland-Yutani, Omni Consumer Products and a few more like it

Custom ships: from logistics, research and salvaging ships to security defense vessels.

These are currently in the modSpoiler[close]

Variety of player flagsSpoiler[close]

Hand drawn portraitsSpoiler[close]

Author's note

: This is a minimum viable product, meaning that while it's playable, there's still a lot of stuff I wanted to add or update but couldn't due to my current condition. I want to at least get it out there so people can try it for themselves. Also this is my very first mod for Starsector. New stuff will be added later down the line once I'm able to. I'm already planning on adding additional ships, weapons, star systems, custom campaign missions and contacts, and maybe even some boss ships as unlockables(they're in the mod but requires

Console Commands

to access them)

I also want to put in proper Nexerelin support among other things, but all in due time

Feedback is greatly appreciated. For now the mod is balanced with the vanilla ships and weapons in mind but they could be a bit overtuned at the moment with the current amount I have added so far. Let me know what needs to change or can be improved on and I'll look into it ASAP

(old ship designs)

This mod is slightly stylized for now, the portraits and background illustrations are subject to change

Special thanks to the following cool people for helping me out on this little mod and giving general advice

:

Whiskey_Project, WMGreywind

Kaysaar and the Modding Bay, Ryxsen1421

MagmarL and a couple more who also helped me out along the way

Changelog

Spoiler29-8-2026 - v.04

Added the Skyhook, a makeshift carrier destroyer with 4 fighter bays.

Added the Hastatus, a destroyer build for suppression.

Added the Keg: Ultra, a massive tanker with compressed anti-matter fuel prone to exploding when used in combat.

Changed the names of the jump points in Hadley starsystem and moved the Gresit jump-point closer

Added descriptions to some ships and weapons

The Aniara colony ships now spawn fighters on destruction

Added 7 more helmet portraits to both NAX and KTAC

Moved some helmet portraits in the Player FACTION file for easier selection, didn't rename anything so it should still work

Reworked the Hambo fighter sprite a bit

Added new illustration for when you visit Rockdown

Fixed the Madden's sounds, no longer screams on destruction

The GUS-X1 Revengeance now has halved ammo count, but is now significantly cheaper(2030 credits from 90k)

The Javelin destroyer has a "Tactical Troop Transport" designation

The Jerrydog cruiser is slightly more expensive(100,000 credits) and has increased Deployment Points(20 DP)

The Express destroyer has a larger mass to make it viable for ramming into other ships like intended.

Made the mod compatible with Version checker

The Thaddeus super capital is no longer available in blueprints so you can't order it in certain missions as intended but the price still has been increased just in case

Author's note

: I made some large changes in the Hadley star system so this update wouldn't work well with older save files I'm afraid. To see those changes in effect you would need to generate a new universe in a new playthrough.

I'm also trying Version Checker for the first time so please let me know if something breaks with this mod.

15-5-2026 - v.03a

Removed "independent_from_carrier" tags from all fighters in the wing_data.csv file. It *should* fix the issue where the battle never ends, despite there being no enemy ships left.

Gave the pilotable Halcyon a unique sprite to differentiate better between the fighter version and the frigate version during combat.

Changed the Corsette G-599 tier from 3 to 4, should make it more rare when encountering it in the wild.

Made fighter variant of some weapons unavailable through normal market purchase.

22-3-2026 - v.03

Fiorna is now habitable which previously was not.

Completely reworked the Anax, has a brand new sprite and additional weapon mounts.

The Corsette G-599 now has only 1 Half Thor missile instead of 10 per run. The fighter is also more expensive to justify its power. The price went from 100,000 to 500,000.

The Broc is now worth more and the Solar Beam Emitter has a longer charge-up time.

The Jerrydog base value went from 55000 to 80000.

The Reverend no longer has the Missile Autoforge hullmod, and instead it has the ship system for it and has the Missile Autoloader as a built-in hullmod.

The GUS-X1 Revengeance now has a different sound when firing it.

The Rockcutter also have a different sound when firing.

The Half Thor on fighters has been nerfed, halved the amount of projectiles on split.

Added new black hole system and market, Brennan (note: The black hole itself is very jank and does not act like a typical black hole found in the sector, will be fixed at some point but might break future saves so keep that in mind)

Added custom music for both faction market and fleet encounters as well as a unique soundtrack for the Koa system.

Added the Madden, a large frigate for hit and run tactics.

Added the Lambert, a point defense frigate.

Added the Pachyderm, a superfreighter.

19-1-2026 - v.02b

Updated ship spawns so now the faction can have them in their fleets more often and fixed issue of some of them not spawning at all.

16-1-2026 - v.02a

The Halcyon F8bs-1A frigate was the major cause of game crashes due to its recursive fighter wing. That has been finally fixed.

The missing ship hull variant in the title screen has been fixed, shouldn't crash randomly anymore due to improperly named ship variant.

Added a military contact. Andrea is the Chief of Security stationed on Fiorna, you can find her at the local bar by selecting "Talk to the lone woman at the bar". Once you talk to her you get some dialogue options. It doesn't matter which one you pick, you'll just get different reactions. If you end the contact you can get her back if you talk to her again.

Added new ships:

-Anax class Capital ship super carrier

-Aniara class Capital Ship Liner for 6000 crew capacity

-Broc class Destroyer with Spinal Solar Beam Emitter

-Hardrock class Destroyer Astroid Thruster Stealth ship

-Keg Class Frigate Tanker with self-destruct system(Code mainly from King Alfonzo's

Luddic Enhancement IED

mod, I've asked for permission to use it in mine)

Added new weapon: Half THOR 2 stage Anti Shield Large Missile.

Added a boss fleet that roams around and protects the Hadley starsystem. (Also added a experimental high level end-game boss ship that roams around)

Author's note

: Thanks for the feedback everyone! I got out of the hospital about 6 weeks ago at the time this writing and I'm pretty much fully recovered so I have a bit more time to work on this mod again. I'll still try to add more to the mod or fix things whenever I'm able.

As usual, please let me know if there's anything that needs to be fixed or improved.

4-12-2025 - v.02

Made it compatible with

Arma Armatura

and

Nexerelin

.

The Halcyon F8bs-1A frigate now has the Strikefighter hullmod from Arma Armatura.

Precision Laser sound has been swapped with the sound from the base game until I can fix the noise-effect.

Updated old portraits and added new ones. Also changed the portrait names to have all lowercase to avoid crashes for Linux users.

Changed some of the ship names in the game files to have the "nax_" prefix instead of the "ktac_" ones which should group both NAX and KTAC ships together when looking through the console command help list.

Author's note

: Overall the mod

should

be a lot more stable now and less likely to crash when Nexerelin spawns mining fleets. Nothing's perfect, so if the mod still crashes the game for ANY reason, please let me know as soon as possible and I'll do my best to fix it.
